title: Carrera Hybrid

scope.basis: Initial documented selection of road pieces and track-mounted accessories.
scope.availability: Historical and current products are mixed; catalogue inclusion does not imply current availability.
excluded: Native slotless snapping and free-driving simulation

defaults.note: Car scale is descriptive. Physical dimensions are millimetres. Centred slot offsets are a nominal model, not manufacturing tolerances.

visualStyle.basis: Original schematic SVG interpretations of the cited product/catalogue illustrations; connector details are illustrative.

sources.title: Carrera Hybrid manufacturer overview and dimensional FAQ
sources.note: 1:50 scale; slotless; 433 × 250 mm straight; standard curve centre radius 375 mm.

sources.title: Carrera Hybrid Track Pack 1
sources.note: Six straights, two left and two right curves.

sources.title: Carrera Hybrid R1 / 30° curves
sources.note: Manufacturer lists this product as pre-order; catalogue presence is not availability.

sources.title: Carrera Fun: own Hybrid track examination
sources.note: Original examination with photos, part letters, 60-degree standard curve, R2 road edges, handed red/blue borders and directional markings.

sourceIssues.detail: Hybrid is reference-only in this version of the slot-track editor. Reference placement is available, but snapping, centreline / per-lane lengths, slot preview and Timing slot routes are not supplied.
Left and right are separate physical parts with directional red/blue edge markings. They are listed separately; reflecting artwork does not make the opposite physical part.

Standard straight and standard curve envelope use manufacturer dimensions. R2 dimensions use the cited independent examination. Special surfaces / accessories have incomplete footprints and remain schematic.
